name: Congonhas - Deputado Freitas Nobre Airport

runway.v: two runways: 17R/35L 1,883 m × 45 m and 17L/35R 1,495 m × 45 m, asphalt

curfew.v: closed 0200-0900 UTC (23:00-06:00 local, UTC-3); night operations only for seriously ill or injured patients, organ transport, search and rescue and military flights, requested by e-mail in advance
curfew.quote: Para operação entre 0200/0900 UTC, o operador da aeronave deve solicitar

ppr.v: general aviation must coordinate with COA SBSP at least 2 hours before operating, through the online form
ppr.quote: ACFT aviação geral deverá COORD com antecedência mínima de 02 horas da sua operação.

slots.v: when the airport is declared coordinated by NOTAM, a slot must be requested in advance
slots.quote: Mediante ativação de AD COOR por meio de NOTAM, há a necessidade de pedido prévio de SLOT.

max_aircraft.v: only aircraft able to use both runways for take-off and landing (except scheduled passenger, medical and organ flights); fixed-wing aircraft need two pilots; no fixed-wing VFR flight plans, training or cargo flights; CAT A aircraft barred from 17L/35R at set times; taxiways S and O limited to 24 m wingspan
max_aircraft.quote: Somente poderão operar ACFT que possam utilizar as duas RWY para decolagem e pouso.

notes: Read DECEA AISWEB ROTAER entry for SBSP (labelled D-AMDT 43/26; administrator AENA Brasil; UTC-3). ROTAER times are UTC; local times are my conversion with UTC-3 as stated in the entry (Brazil has no summer time). CAT A rule: 'Aeronaves CAT A proibido OPS LDG e TKOF na RWY 17L/35R de MON/TUE TIL FRI/SAT de 1000-1300 e 2200-0000' (UTC), with exceptions incl. MEDEVAC, military and RBAC 121/135. Two-pilot rule has an exception for some airline-pilot flights. SBSP may not be used as an alternate. The ROTAER entry does not list customs or fuel; the eAIP AD 2 SBSP was not read. Trip facts: 23:00-06:00 local closure, two pilots mandatory, 1,883 m runway.
